high_level_description: The image features a portrait of an individual standing outdoors under a clear blue sky. The person is wearing glasses and a dark blue polo shirt. The background is simple and uncluttered, emphasizing the subject. On the left side of the image, there is a block of text that reads: "I've gone from believing that if you ask questions, it meant you're fundamentally not smart, to believing that the more you ask, the more curious you are, the smarter you get." This quote suggests a shift in perspective regarding curiosity and intelligence.
